## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Capacity planning using velocity and focus factor
- WIP limits and Definition of Ready
- Backlog guardrails and stakeholder communication
- Lightweight metrics for predictability and throughput

```javascript

function capacity(hoursPerWeek, weeks, focus = 0.65) {
  return hoursPerWeek * weeks * focus;
}
```

- How would you visualize these metrics to non-technical stakeholders?

3) Collect stakeholder feedback on clarity of backlog and decision logs; adjust cadence accordingly.
